name: hamburg-transit-designer
description: Hamburg Transit Network Designer — draw the transit network you want and find out what it would take to build it.

scripts.data:fetch: node tools/importer/fetch-transit.mjs && node tools/importer/fetch-stations.mjs && node tools/importer/fetch-geo.mjs && node tools/importer/fetch-planned.mjs && node tools/importer/fetch-statistics.mjs && node tools/importer/fetch-region.mjs
scripts.data:build: node tools/importer/build-network.mjs && node tools/importer/build-city.mjs && node tools/importer/build-projects.mjs && npm run engine:import
scripts.data:build:berlin: node tools/importer/build-network.mjs --city=berlin && node tools/importer/build-city.mjs --city=berlin && node tools/importer/build-projects.mjs --city=berlin && npm run engine:import:berlin
scripts.engine:import:berlin: cd rust && cargo run --release -p hh-cli --bin hh -- import --city=berlin
scripts.engine:import: cd rust && cargo run --release -p hh-cli --bin hh -- import
scripts.engine:calibrate: cd rust && cargo run --release -p hh-cli --bin hh -- calibrate
scripts.engine:bench: cd rust && cargo run --release -p hh-cli --bin hh -- bench
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run engine:test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:engine && npm run test:flow && npm run test:api && npm run test:browser && npm run test:security
